about.description: Welcome to Netflish, your (slightly illicit) escape hatch from reality. Forked with love and a disregard for the rules, we run on a private VPS, ad-free, because we believe your eyeballs deserve better.

q1.body: Netflish doesn't hoard files like a digital dragon. When you click 'play,' we send our tiny internet minions to find your chosen media. (Check loading/sources tab for their adventures). No uploads here, just clever searching.
q1.title: Where does the content come from?

q2.body: Requesting specific shows or movies? Alas, Netflish is more of a 'discover what's out there' kind of deal. We don't manage the library, just the access.
q2.title: Where can I request a show or movie?

q3.body: Our search results, powered by TMDB, are eternal optimists. They show up even if our sources are still playing hard to get. Patience, or try another source!
q3.title: The search results display the show or movie, why can't I play it?

q4.body: Your data syncs to the community backend. It's out there. Use it, abuse it (not really), it's yours.
q4.title: What about my data and stuff?

q5.body: Netflish has a Discord server where the cool kids (and us) hang out. Link's in the header!
q5.title: How can I find out more?

support.title: Support Netflish (We need therapy sometimes too)
support.text: Netflish aims to be easy. But life (and tech) throws curveballs. This page helps.

q1.body: Join the official <0>Netflish discord</0> (we promise we're friendly-ish) or email us at the bottom.
q1.title: Where can I get help for this magnificent beast?

q2.body: We have a <0>GitHub</0> (where code dreams go to... be debugged) for detailed issues. Or, fix it yourself and become a Netflish legend!
q2.title: How can I report a bug or issue?

jip.title: The Netflish Origin Story (aka 'Jip')
jip.text: Netflish didn't just magically appear. It was lovingly (and sometimes frustratingly) cobbled together by one human (Ish) who just wanted a cooler, ad-free way to watch stuff. And then decided to share. Because sharing is caring, even if it's slightly against the grain.

q1.body: Join the <0>Netflish discord</0> and ask the creator (Ish) or the awesome community. Or use the email at the bottom.
q1.title: Where can I get help for this... creation?

q2.body: Head to the <0>GitHub</0> to report bugs. Feel free to contribute; we love free labor (just kidding... mostly).
q2.title: How can I report a bug in Netflish?
